# Insulin Lispro

**Authors:** Noreen Islam, Niloufar R. Khanna, Preeti Patel, Patrick M. Zito

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Insulin lispro, an FDA-approved insulin analog, is an effective treatment for regulating hyperglycemia in type 1 and 2 diabetes. This medication extends its utility beyond its primary indication, finding application in off-label uses such as managing mild-to-moderate diabetic ketoacidosis, gestational diabetes, and mild-to-moderate hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state.
